passage.label: Al-Ma'idah — Disbelievers ransom rejected even with earth's wealth; painful enduring punishment; desire to exit Fire impossible; thief male and female cut off hands as recompense deterrent from Allah; Allah Exalted Wise; whoever repents after wrongdoing and reforms Allah accepts repentance; Allah Forgiving Merciful; Allah owns dominion heavens earth punishes forgives whom He wills; over all things Capable

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡ أَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا وَمِثۡلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لِيَفۡتَدُواْ بِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ مَا تُقُبِّلَ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَخۡرُجُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمَا هُم بِخَٰرِجِينَ مِنۡهَاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّقِيمٞ
وَٱلسَّارِقُ وَٱلسَّارِقَةُ فَٱقۡطَعُوٓاْ أَيۡدِيَهُمَا جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَسَبَا نَكَٰلٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٞ
فَمَن تَابَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ظُلۡمِهِۦ وَأَصۡلَحَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَتُوبُ عَلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
أَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَغۡفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

mainSubject.label: Disbelievers cannot ransom themselves from Resurrection punishment; enduring torment in Fire; theft penalty hand amputation as divine deterrent; repentance after wrongdoing accepted by Allah; divine sovereignty over punishment and forgiveness

subordinateSubjects.label: Ransom rejection: all earth's wealth insufficient for disbelievers on Resurrection Day
Enduring punishment: desire to leave Fire never granted
Theft penalty: hand amputation for male and female thieves as exemplary deterrent
Repentance acceptance: reform after wrongdoing earns divine forgiveness
Divine dominion: Allah punishes and forgives whom He wills; over all things Capable

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: وَٱلسَّارِقُ وَٱلسَّارِقَةُ فَٱقۡطَعُوٓاْ أَيۡدِيَهُمَا جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَسَبَا نَكَٰلٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٞ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Command: cut off hands of male and female thieves as recompense for what they earned.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: فَمَن تَابَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ظُلۡمِهِۦ وَأَصۡلَحَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَتُوبُ عَلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Declaration: whoever repents after wrongdoing and reforms, Allah accepts his repentance.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Futile desire to escape Fire after entering it
Repentance and reform as pathway to divine acceptance

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Theft deterrence through corporal punishment as societal protection

notes: Pass A Maidah passage 5/8. Transitions from hirabah penalties (end of P4) to theft hadd. Repentance clause (5:39) parallels 5:34 hirabah exception establishing consistent mercy framework within penal legislation. Divine sovereignty declaration (5:40) grounds both punishment and forgiveness in Allah's exclusive authority preventing human despair or presumption.
